description: Source code implementing thread creation and management functions for Windows platform, including thread creation, priority setting, and thread-local storage cleanup.

methods.name: ResetWinError
methods.description: Resets the last error code to zero.

methods.name: RunThreadLocalDestructors
methods.description: Runs destructors for thread-local storage objects, multiple passes to handle objects inserted during destructors.

methods.name: CountTlsObjectsRemaining
methods.description: Counts remaining thread-local storage objects with destructors.

methods.name: CallThreadLocalDestructorsMultipleTimes
methods.description: Calls thread-local destructors multiple times to ensure cleanup of all TLS objects.

methods.name: ThreadTrampoline
methods.description: Thread entry point that sets thread-local data, runs user function, and handles cleanup.

methods.name: SbThreadCreate
methods.description: Creates a new thread with specified parameters, including stack size, priority, and entry point.

methods.name: SbThreadSetPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority of the current thread.

methods.name: SbThreadGetPriority
methods.description: Retrieves the priority of the current thread.
